title: pteris boivinii
intro: Pteris boivinii, commonly known as the Boivin's brake fern, is a species of fern belonging to the family Pteridaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Pteris boivinii include wound healing, pain relief, and the treatment of respiratory and gastrointestinal disorders. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
